rationale: Both bring deep computer vision and AI expertise to robotics and medical applications—Stiven's work on surgical AR navigation using real-time 3D guidance and Shan's embodied AI robotics platform represent adjacent technical challenges in deploying vision systems at scale. While Stiven is focused on fundraising and FDA compliance for Braillic's ArNav platform, Ruyi Dynamics' hardware-software integration and AI deployment experience could offer relevant architectural insights for scaling medical AI systems.
intro_message: Stiven Ding, meet Shan—you're both working on computer vision and AI in complex physical systems (surgical AR vs. embodied robotics), and might find each other's technical approaches to real-time 3D guidance and hardware integration worth discussing.
